{{EventEnd|The Hunt Event|date=30th of March 2024}} {{For|[[The Hunt: Mega Edition Event]]}} {{EventInfobox |image1 = TheHuntThumbnailClean.png |dates = 15 March 2024 – 30 March 2024 |part_of = Roblox's [[w:c:roblox:The_Hunt|The Hunt: First Edition]] |previous_event = [[Krampus' Revenge Event|Krampus' Revenge]] |next_event = [[April Fools 2024 Event|Skibidi]] }} ==Description== '''The Hunt Event''' was the fourteenth event to be added in Tower Defense Simulator. This was a Roblox sponsored event that takes part in [[w:c:roblox:The_Hunt|The Hunt: First Edition]] event. The event was released on 15 March 2024 on 17:00 UTC and ended on 30 March 2024 on 19:00 UTC. Similar to [[Spring 2020 Event]], '''The Hunt Event''' consisted of two gamemodes, the beginner and hard mode. Upon completing the beginner mode, players would be rewarded with a [[Badges|badge]] and the [[Quests#The Hunt Quest|After The Hunt]] quest. Upon completing the hard mode, players would be rewarded with the [[Warden/Gallery#Korblox|{{Color|Korblox|Korblox}} Warden]] skin. ==Maps== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:HuevousHuntIcon.png|200px|link=Huevous Hunt]] |- |[[Huevous Hunt]] |} ==Skins== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:KorbloxWardenIcon.png|175x175px]] |- |[[Warden/Gallery|{{Color|Korblox|Korblox}} Warden]]Obtained from beating the event in the Hard difficulty. |} ==Accessories== {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:ScoutEggHat.png|175px|Link=]] |- ! |{{RLinkC|16736381810|Scout Egg}} |- !Obtainment Method |[[Quests#After The Hunt|After The Hunt]] Quest |- !Stock |200,000 |} ==Enemies== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:Korbloxseeker.png|150px|link=Korblox Seeker (The Hunt)]] |[[File:KorbloxGuard.png|150px|link=Korblox Guard (The Hunt)]] |[[File:KorbloxUndead.png|150px|link=Korblox Undead (The Hunt)]] |[[File:KorbloxSoul.png|150px|link=Korblox Soul (The Hunt)]] |[[File:Korblox Warrior.png|150px|link=Korblox Warrior (The Hunt)]] |- |[[Korblox Seeker (The Hunt)|Korblox Seeker]]

1 Total |} ==Badges== {{Badge |title = Defeat Deathwalker! {{!}} The Hunt First Edition |description = This badge was earned by completing Tower Defense Simulator's Gamemode for The Hunt: First Edition. |image = THBadge1.png |obtainable = No }} {{Badge |title = Eggs?!? |description = Eggs. |image = THBadge2.png |obtainable = No }} ==Official Event Trailer== [[File:The Hunt Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|750px|thumb|center]] ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} TheHuntThumbnail.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} TheHuntIcon.png MBRTHIcon.png {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} TheHuntPI.png }} ==Trivia== *This is the fifth event to be sponsored by Roblox, the others being the [[Area 51 Event|Area 51]], [[Halloween 2019 Event|Halloween 2019]], [[Spring 2020 Event|Spring 2020]] and [[Metaverse Champions Event|Metaverse Champions]] events. *This is the first event in the game to not allow grouped matches, meaning it can only be played in solo. **This is only true for the Beginner mode, as Hard mode still allowed grouped matches. *This event is the third shortest event in Tower Defense Simulator. {{EventNavBox}}
